selection_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
selection_decisions.reason: Exported signatures, validation-error identity, JSON bytes, accepted-prefix effects, and CLI process contracts must be preserved.

selection_decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
selection_decisions.reason: The task adds CSV, refresh, recurrence, cancellation, and real process behavior and expressly requests consequential regression tests.

selection_decisions.name: go-core-style
selection_decisions.reason: Implementation and tests are Go code; apply ordinary formatting, guard clauses, errors as values, and proportionate standard-library design.

selection_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selection_decisions.reason: Refresh borrows a supplied client and context; Serve owns sequential callback completion and resource release; the command owns signal and client transport lifetimes.

selection_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
selection_decisions.reason: CSV ingestion, HTTP refresh, and lifecycle responsibilities are being implemented; the existing cohesive library and command suffice without a package split.

selection_decisions.name: go-test-isolation
selection_decisions.reason: Tests own temporary paths, listeners, bodies, goroutines, timers, file-size-limited children, and real executable processes.
